reply.text:
I can't give you a yes or no on that one, and no amounts either. At 15, a supplement question belongs with your doctor, and it's worth bringing a parent into that conversation too.

What I can say in general terms: most of what a teenager needs to get stronger comes from consistent training, enough sleep, and eating enough food with decent protein. Those do the heavy lifting by a wide margin.

If you want, I can build you a program or a session. What are you training for right now?
